title: Automated RNA Extraction and RT-PCR Protocol
author: Amy Lyden
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfi2jkge
materials: Zymo DNA/RNA Shield - Add 500uL of 2x Zymo DNA/RNA Shield into 2mL deep well plates (for addition of samples not collected in shield) in a PCR Workstation. Aliquot using the Thermo Multidrop liquid dispenser. Seal with ThermoFisher blue rubber seals and store at room temperature.

Viral DNA/RNA Buffer - Add 1 ml beta-mercaptoethanol (BME) per 200 ml Viral DNA/RNA Buffer, final concentration 0.5% (v/v). Aliquot 450uL of Viral DNA/RNA Buffer with BME using the Thermo Multidrop in 1mL 96 deep well plate Seal and store at RT protected from light, up to a week prior to nucleic acid extraction.

Magbeads - Vortex MagBeads and aliquot into a 1mL deep well source plate. Mix with Integra Viaflo 96. Aliquot 30uL using the Integra Viaflo 96 into Bio-Rad 96 PCR plate. You must mix the MagBeads between each aliquot to avoid settling. Seal and store upside down to avoid settling, at room temperature up to a week prior to nucleic acid extraction.

MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 1 & 2 - Add 80mL of isopropanol to the MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 1 concentrate. Add 120mL of isopropanol to the MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 2 concentrate. Aliquot 550uL of DNA/RNA Magbead Wash Buffers 1 and 2 using the Thermo Multidrop into 1mL 96 deep well plate. Heat seal and store at room temperature in a flammables cabinet, up to a week prior to nucleic acid extraction.

Ethanol - Aliquot 1.1mL of 100% ethanol, using the Thermo Multidrop, into a 1mL 96 deep well plate plate. Heat seal and store at room temperature in a flammables cabinet, up to a week prior to nucleic acid extraction.

DNAse I - Add 275 µl DNase/RNase-Free Water to reconstitute the lyophilized DNase I at 1 U/µl. Mix by gentle inversion. Aliquot 55uL of DNAse I in DNAse Digestion buffer, using the Thermo Multidrop in Bio-Rad 96 PCR plate. Seal and store at 4C for for up to a week.
RNA Prep Buffer - Aliquot 550uL of RNA Prep Buffer using the Thermo Multidrop into 1mL 96 deep well plate. Heat seal and store at room temperature, up to a week prior to nucleic acid extraction.
Water - Aliquot 100uL of DNAse/RNAse free water using the Thermo Multidrop into Bio-Rad 96 PCR plate, sealed and stored at room temperature, up to a week prior to nucleic acid extraction
NTC : Use nuclease-free water as NTC.
Gather all other reagents EXCEPT the DNase I plate and qPCR MM plate. Inspect the reagent plates to make sure they appear to have equal volumes in each well.
Pick up an empty sealed barcoded Full skirt Bio-Rad PCR plate for RNA

steps.title: Label and barcode reagents
steps.instruction: Barcode all reagent plates, record each plate barcode and lot numbers for DNAse, DNAse Digestion Buffer and water; label reagents with human‑readable IDs and numbers for Bravo matching.

steps.title: Prepare Proteinase K stock
steps.instruction: Add 1.2 mL Proteinase K Storage Buffer to each 20 mg lyophilized Proteinase K vial to make a 20 mg/mL stock; aliquot 3 µL of this stock into a 1 mL 96‑deep‑well plate using the Integra Viaflo 96, seal and store at –20 °C (up to 1 week).

steps.title: Prepare Human RNA control
steps.instruction: Make 1× PBS from 10× stock with nuclease‑free water; mix 1× PBS with 2× Shield 1:1 to obtain PBS:Shield; dilute extracted HeLa RNA 1:1000 in PBS:Shield to 120 ng/mL, invert, spin down, aliquot 2 × 500 µL per plate, store at 4 °C (≤7 days).

steps.title: Prepare Positive control
steps.instruction: Dilute high‑titer patient sample (10⁷ cp/mL in Shield) to 10⁵ cp/mL in the HRC solution prepared above, invert, spin down, aliquot 2 × 500 µL per plate, store at 4 °C (≤7 days).

steps.title: Prepare 1× PBS
steps.instruction: Dilute 10× PBS stock with nuclease‑free water to obtain 1× PBS.

steps.title: Prepare primer‑probe mixes
steps.instruction: Dilute each primer‑probe mix 1:20 for the final qPCR reaction (0.5 µL per 10 µL reaction).

steps.title: Prepare qPCR mastermix
steps.instruction: For one 96‑well plate (10 µL per reaction) prepare 980 µL total (960 µL for reactions + 20 µL excess) according to the composition table; do not add sample yet.

steps.title: Dispense mastermix to qPCR plate
steps.instruction: Using the Dragonfly, plate 6 µL mastermix per well into a Bio‑Rad 384‑well PCR plate; assign Assay 1 = N‑gene, Assay 2 = E‑gene, Assay 3 = RNaseP.

steps.title: Spin down and freeze qPCR plate
steps.instruction: Spin the qPCR plate at 1000 rpm for 1 min, cover with foil, and store at –20 °C until use.

steps.title: Decontaminate workstation
steps.instruction: Spray RNaseZAP on all surfaces and wipe; then spray 70 % ethanol and wipe.

steps.title: Thaw Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Remove Proteinase K plate from –20 °C and allow it to thaw before starting extraction.

steps.title: Spin down plates
steps.instruction: Spin all plates (except the RNA plate and Magbead plates) at 215 rcf for 1 min; also spin DNase I and qPCR plates when prompted.

steps.title: Organize plates for extraction
steps.instruction: Arrange plates in the exact order they will be used during the extraction protocol.

steps.title: Spin down sample plate
steps.instruction: Spin the sample plate (stored at 4 °C) for 1 min at 215 rcf and keep it sealed until needed.

steps.title: Power on Bravo
steps.instruction: Turn on the Agilent Bravo instrument and launch the VWorks software.

steps.title: Open RNA extraction form
steps.instruction: Open the RNA extraction VWorks form that links to the protocol.

steps.title: Set up Bravo deck
steps.instruction: Configure the deck per the VWorks form layout: place a 2 mL deep‑well waste plate, foil seals, optical clear seals, blue rubber seals, waste bags, and Agilent tip boxes.

steps.title: Run extraction protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run Protocol” and follow on‑screen prompts to unseal reagent plates, retrieve plates from the freezer, and dispose of waste and tips in appropriate bins.

steps.title: Add sample to Proteinase K plate
steps.instruction: Bravo transfers 180 µL of each stock sample into a 1 mL deep‑well plate that already contains 3 µL of 20 mg/mL Proteinase K (Deck 5).

steps.title: Add mix to samples
steps.instruction: Bravo adds 360 µL of the prepared mix from Deck 9 to each well on Deck 5 and mixes.

steps.title: Add magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Bravo adds 20 µL magnetic beads from Deck 6 to each well on Deck 5, mixes, and incubates for 10 min.

steps.title: First bead capture
steps.instruction: Move the plate to the magnet on Deck 7, incubate 5 min, then remove supernatant to waste on Deck 1.

steps.title: Wash 1
steps.instruction: Swap Deck 9 reagent plate to Magbead DNA/RNA Wash Buffer 1; Bravo adds 500 µL Wash 1 to Deck 5, mixes, moves to magnet (Deck 7) for 5 min, then removes supernatant to waste (Deck 1).

steps.title: Wash 2
steps.instruction: Swap Deck 9 to Magbead DNA/RNA Wash Buffer 2; Bravo adds 500 µL Wash 2 to Deck 5, mixes, magnet incubation 5 min (Deck 7), then remove supernatant to waste (Deck 1).

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Swap Deck 9 to 100 % ethanol (first wash); Bravo adds 500 µL ethanol to Deck 5, mixes, incubates on magnet (Deck 7) for 2 min, then removes supernatant to waste (Deck 1).

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat ethanol addition: Bravo adds another 500 µL ethanol from Deck 9 to Deck 5, mixes, incubates 2 min on magnet (Deck 7), and removes supernatant to waste (Deck 1).

steps.title: DNase treatment
steps.instruction: Swap Deck 9 to DNase mix (DNase + Digestion Buffer + water); Bravo adds 50 µL DNase mix to Deck 5, mixes, and incubates Deck 5 for 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: RNA prep buffer addition
steps.instruction: Swap Deck 9 to RNA Prep Buffer; Bravo adds 500 µL to Deck 5, mixes, moves plate to magnet (Deck 7) for 5 min, then removes supernatant to waste (Deck 1).

steps.title: Second ethanol wash series
steps.instruction: Swap Deck 9 to 100 % ethanol (two washes): for each wash, Bravo adds 500 µL ethanol to Deck 5, mixes, incubates on magnet (Deck 7) for 2 min, and removes supernatant to waste (Deck 1).

steps.title: Water elution
steps.instruction: Swap Deck 9 to 100 % nuclease‑free water; Bravo adds 45 µL water to Deck 5, mixes, incubates on magnet (Deck 7) for 5 min, then collects eluate from Deck 7 into the final plate on Deck 3.

steps.title: Spin down eluate and transfer RNA
steps.instruction: Spin the eluate plate at 215 rcf for 1 min, then immediately transfer the extracted RNA into a pre‑prepared 384‑well qPCR plate.

steps.title: Clean Bravo deck
steps.instruction: Wipe the Bravo deck clean after extraction.

steps.title: Set up qPCR plating
steps.instruction: Open the qPCR plating VWorks form; place the spun‑down RNA plate on Deck 6 and the thawed qPCR mastermix plate on Deck 9; configure any additional deck items as shown in the form.

steps.title: Run qPCR plating protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run protocol”; Bravo aliquots 4 µL RNA into the A1, B1 and A2 quadrants of the 384‑well qPCR plate.

steps.title: Seal and spin qPCR plate
steps.instruction: Seal the qPCR plate with a Bio‑Rad optical seal (avoid touching the seal surface, remove tabs), then spin at 215 rcf for 1 min.

steps.title: Run qPCR
steps.instruction: Run the qPCR program on a Bio‑Rad CFX thermocycler, detecting both FAM and HEX fluorescence channels.

steps.title: Shield sample pipette transfer
steps.instruction: Perform any additional pipette transfers for Shield‑treated samples inside a PCR hood or BSC.

steps.title: Prepare control layout
steps.instruction: Transfer 600 µL of each appropriate control into a 96‑well 2 mL deep‑well plate according to the provided layout image.

steps.title: Swab removal and disposal
steps.instruction: In a biosafety cabinet, carefully remove swabs from samples, dispose in biohazard waste, using tweezers, upside‑down tips and gauze; change gloves if contaminated.

steps.title: Add shield to control wells
steps.instruction: From a pre‑prepared plate containing 500 µL of 2× DNA/RNA Shield, remove 500 µL from wells designated for controls and add 600 µL of the indicated control to each.

steps.title: Add samples to shield plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL of up to 84 samples into the remaining empty wells, record barcodes and well locations, mix with 2× DNA/RNA Shield, avoid cross‑contamination, and inspect for high viscosity or debris.

steps.title: Decontaminate for Hamilton
steps.instruction: Spray RNaseZAP on the workstation, wipe; then spray 70 % ethanol and wipe.

steps.title: Start Hamilton robot
steps.instruction: Turn on the computer and Hamilton robot; open the ‘Sample Reformatting’ shortcut on the desktop.

steps.title: Configure Hamilton GUI
steps.instruction: Press Play, select site, enter user name, continue; set number of patient samples (exclude controls), choose recapping option, enable barcode scanning, set volume to 600 µL per plate, select tube type based on inner diameter (≈12 mm = small, ≈13.5 mm = large), enable ‘Process transfer from control tubes’.

steps.title: Load tip racks
steps.instruction: Load Hamilton 1000 µL conductive filter tips into the tip‑rack carrier lanes 1‑6; calculate required tips as (number of tubes × number of plates) + 16.

steps.title: Load tip locations in GUI
steps.instruction: Select tip locations in the GUI according to the physical tip boxes loaded.

steps.title: Load tube rack carriers
steps.instruction: Place tube‑rack carriers labeled 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18 onto the robot lanes; ensure barcodes are visible through carrier windows.

steps.title: Load control tubes
steps.instruction: Load NTC, PC, HRC and PBS control tubes into the specified carriers and positions: NTC – carrier 8 pos 1 & 8, carrier 18 pos 1 & 8, pos 9 & 16; PC – carrier 14 pos 9 & 16; HRC – carrier 16 pos 1 & 8; PBS – carrier 16 pos 9 & 16.

steps.title: Load sample tubes
steps.instruction: Load sample tubes into remaining empty slots of the tube‑rack carriers, starting with lane 8, positions 1‑16, skipping any occupied by control tubes; this column order determines placement on the deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Confirm deck loading
steps.instruction: Confirm via the GUI that all deep‑well plates and tube racks are in the correct positions; verify barcode reads, resolve any errors with a handheld scanner.

steps.title: Run Hamilton transfer protocol
steps.instruction: Start the Hamilton protocol; watch for drips or tip failures, note any wells that did not receive sample.

steps.title: Post‑run cleanup
steps.instruction: Dispose of waste, wipe the deck with 70 % ethanol, seal the sample plate with a blue rubber seal, and recap all tubes.

steps.title: Export barcode CSV
steps.instruction: Export a CSV file containing barcodes for each processed 2 mL deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Record primer‑probe sources
steps.instruction: Note that N‑gene, E‑gene and RNaseP primers and probes are manufactured by IDT in a template‑free facility.

steps.title: Interpret qPCR results
steps.instruction: Positive control must have Ct < 38 for N, E and RNase P; NTC and PBS must be negative (no fluorescence crossing threshold); RNase P must be ≤ 38 for HRC and negative clinical samples; HRC must be negative for viral targets; report any unexpected control results, clusters of positives, >4 indeterminate/invalid wells, or >10 positives to the supervisor before final reporting.

steps.title: Define result categories
steps.instruction: Negative: no viral markers cross threshold and RNase P positive; Positive: both viral markers cross threshold with Cp < 40 (RNase P optional); Indeterminate: only one viral marker positive or any viral Ct > 40; Invalid: none of the targets cross threshold. Repeat testing for indeterminate or invalid results.
